## Pawa AI Python SDK v0.2.0

First public release of the official Python SDK for [Pawa AI](https://pawa-ai.com).

### Highlights

- **Sync & async clients** — `PawaAI` and `AsyncPawaAI`
- **Chat** — completions, streaming helpers, typed responses
- **Voice** — text-to-speech and speech-to-text
- **Embeddings** — vector generation for RAG and search
- **Documents, agents, knowledge base, transcribe** — full API coverage
- **Retry/backoff** — configurable `RetryConfig` for production use
- **PyPI** — install with `pip install pawa-ai`

### Install

```bash
pip install pawa-ai
```

### Quick example

```python
from pawa_ai import PawaAI

client = PawaAI()
response = client.chat.create(
    model="pawa-v1-ember-20240924",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Habari!"}]}],
)
print(response.text)
```
